mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the last 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% in 3 months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST shows a sustained increase over 3 months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the last 2 months signals increased economic activity, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% in 2 months and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 70% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over the last quarter, it signals a consumption-driven economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in last quarter
failure_condition: If RSAFS grows faster than GDPC1 in the last quarter and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in the last month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 70% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is above 2% and CPIAUCSL is rising, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in the last 3 months signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases by more than 2% in 3 months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.
